lines.text: Many learners say: Can you borrow me a pen?
Better: Can you lend me a pen?
Lend is to give. Borrow is to take.
Lend! Can you lend me some money?

data.wrong: Can you borrow me a pen?
data.right: Can you lend me a pen?
data.why: Lend is to give. Borrow is to take.

native.tip: «أعار» و«استعار» من جذر واحد فنخلط بينهما، لكن lend للمعطي وborrow للآخذ: “Can you lend me a pen?” وليس “Can you borrow me a pen?”

en.tip: In Arabic the words for lend and borrow come from one root, so we mix them up, but lend is to give and borrow is to take: “Can you lend me a pen?” not “Can you borrow me a pen?”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “Can you borrow me a pen?” 😅 In Arabic the words for lend and borrow come from one root, so we mix them up, but lend is to give and borrow is to take, so the right sentence is “Can you lend me a pen?” Listen to Ama and repeat!
